revision_summary: Three quote timestamp errors must be corrected in script_coverage: (1) 'Was it was there a time that works best for you?' is at 01:26, not 01:05 (01:05 is actually 'Was there was there a good day next week? Or'); (2) 'Maybe ten. I should be free.' is at 01:37, not 01:05; (3) customer's 'Alright. Thanks.' is at 02:06, not 01:45 (01:45 is rep speaking about text reconfirmation). Fix the ts fields in script_coverage[11] and [12] accordingly. Additionally: tighten the schema reference in cherry_pick_moments[3] away from trust_building_micro_trades toward friction_resolution_speed/objection_inversion, which fit the dialer-to-booking flip more precisely. Add the missed moment at 01:47 ('if anything comes up...we could always get that rescheduled') to cherry_pick_moments as a button_up/commitment-strength gap, since it undercuts the verbal handshake on an already resigned customer and is directly relevant to show-rate risk. Resolve the wishy-washy outcome_dispute language in trajectory_verdict — either commit to a fragile-booking framing (consistent with SESSION6/SESSION20 precedent in the schema) or remove the doubt-casting language; as written it raises concern without taking a position. Re-examine the alternative_hypothesis at 00:50 (prior_contact_probe_miss) — the 'strategic economy' framing is a weak unsupported rationalization for what more plausibly reads as the rep simply not acknowledging the complaint.
